QGIS Project Import and Aggregation

Source: R/qgis_import.R
qgis_import.Rd

Read a GeoPackage produced by a QGIS or QField field session back into R, validate its contents against the placette/arbre schema, and compute per-plot aggregates that can be consumed by the core indicators (P1 volume, P2 site index, B2 structure, etc.).

Companion of create_qgis_project — the same schemas (get_placette_schema, get_arbre_schema) define both the outbound form and the inbound validation rules.

Developed by Pascal Obstétar.
